name: dagrunner
description: A thin DAG runner that orchestrates Claude Code (Agent SDK) across git worktrees, with checkpoint-and-exit conversation-led gates. Owns only what has no native Claude Code primitive that survives across processes/worktrees; reuses Claude Code for everything else.

scripts.smoke:mock: node --import tsx ./test/smoke/smoke-mock.ts && node --import tsx ./test/smoke/smoke-gates.ts && node --import tsx ./test/smoke/smoke-ui.ts
scripts.verify-baseline: npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke:mock
